newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Brussels Bourse pushed to new levels in July.
newsitem.headline: Brussels Bourse pushed to new levels in July.

text.p: The Brussels Stock Exchange said on Wednesday that July was yet another record month, with total volume reaching 128.9 billion Belgian francs, up 5.1 percent on June which itself had been a record month.
Traded volume in Union Miniere stock took up the single largest portion of July's total with 8.2 billion francs, followed by shares in PetroFina and UCB.

All three are in the Bel-20 share index .BFX, which in July rose by 8.34 percent, approaching January 1996's record increase of 8.37 percent in a single month. The main supporting factor for the bourse was the higher dollar.
The Bel-20 gain help boost market capitalization to 5,231.5 billion francs, up 61 percent on July 1996.
The chemical sector, led by UCB, rose by 14.6 percent; the steel sector by 21.9 percent, both outperforming the Bel-20.
